name: Mage’s Persistent Blade
body:
School evocation [force]; Level bloodrager 1, magus 1, psychic 1, sorcerer/wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, F (a masterwork or magical dagger)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Effect one dagger of force
Duration 1 round/2 levels
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

A small blade of force blinks into existence that resembles the knife used as a focus for this spell. The blade can move up to 40 feet and attack a designated target within the spell’s range. Directing the dagger to a target is a swift action except on the turn the spell is cast where it is a free action. The blade attacks once per round on your turn unless it has no target. The weapon uses your base attack bonus and your spellcasting ability modifier for the attack roll and has a critical threat range of 19-20. The dagger also gains any enhancement bonus to the attack possessed by the dagger used as a focus.

The dagger deals 1d4 damage plus your spellcasting ability modifier and any enhancement bonus on the dagger used as a focus. No other properties on the dagger are transferred to the mage’s persistent blade.

This dagger will move to flank a target if it is able to on the directed target. The blade is made of force and can strike ethereal and incorporeal creatures. If the target has spell resistance, the spell resistance is checked before the first attack. If the caster level check fails, the dagger is unable to target that creature for the duration of the spell. The blade has an AC 14 (+2 size, +2 Dex) and has 1 hit point.
